pinned_source.title: An algorithm for the satisfiability problem of formulas in conjunctive normal form
pinned_source.license: No source-code license asserted; clean-room mathematical algorithm

contract.formula: Clauses are ordered lists of unique-variable signed one-based literals. Positive v is x_v and negative -v is not x_v.
contract.prefix_size: At a call with m0 clauses, k=1+the least integer strictly greater than log2(m0), equivalently m0.bit_length()+1; truncate each clause to its first k literals.
contract.ppz_attempt: Visit every variable not fixed by an ancestor in supplied permutation order, including variables absent from the truncated formula. Prefer a positive unit clause, then a negative unit clause, otherwise use the random bit at that variable's position in the permutation filtered to unfixed variables and count a guess. Simplify after each assignment and return success only when no empty clause remains.
contract.recursive_step: If PPZ fails and a clause has at least k literals, select the supplied zero-based index among eligible current clauses in order, falsify its first k literals, simplify the original current formula, and recurse. If no eligible clause exists, fail. A selected index outside the current eligible set is invalid.
contract.random_tape: There are n+1 rows. Each row contains a permutation of 1..n, n bits in {0,1}, and a clause choice in [0,m). Bits are indexed by position after filtering the permutation to variables not fixed by ancestors; forced variables ignore their bit, while absent variables use their bit as a guess. Every row is validated, including unused rows. The supplied tape defines one deterministic trace and makes no probability claim.
contract.output: [found,assignment_mask,calls,unit_forces,random_guesses,max_depth] as six signed-i64 words. Bit v-1 is x_v; failed solves emit mask zero. At an empty-formula terminal, variables not fixed by branches default false. Random guesses include variables absent from the shortened formula. Root depth is zero.
contract.error_timing: Validate the complete frame and finish the bounded solve before output capacity handling. Invalid input returns -1.

workspace.meaning: Bounded formulas, recursive residuals, tape rows, and staged output for n<=6 and m<=4.
